title: The Host's Share of an Accepted Loss: Basis of Measurement
content:
Every accepted loss under the Keyturn Host Protection Plan carries the host's own share, booked against the enrolment the claim was made under.

### The share

The host's share of an accepted loss is measured at the deductible the plan publishes, carried in full, and it is never more than the money the plan accepted on the claim, which the marketplace takes as the largest amount an appraisal on the enrolment has booked as owed to the host. The share is rounded half up to two decimal places once, after every rate has been applied, and the ceiling on it is applied to that rounded figure.

### The deductible each plan publishes

| Plan | Deductible, USD |
|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 3000 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 2500 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 1500 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 750 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 500 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 0 |

Every figure the plan publishes, its deductible, its claim-free discount, its qualifying period and the waiver period among them, is read from the plan the enrolment is written on.

### Worked figures (hypothetical)

Where the largest amount an appraisal on the enrolment has booked as owed to the host is 9000 and the vehicle is written on the Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan, the share is 1500.00, that plan's published deductible. Where that largest booked amount is 900 on the same plan, the share is 900.00, because the share is never more than the money the plan accepted on the claim and the ceiling bites. On the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan, whose published deductible is 0, the share is 0.00 whatever the loss.
